notes: Machine-readable prerequisites for the 999-setup distribution (manual M3). Every entry here is one a Claude Code user can satisfy from this repository alone: the five vendored provider helpers, the KIE credential, Python 3 and FFmpeg. Checks are presence/identity only: nothing here executes a provider call, prints a credential, or stands in for an authorization receipt. Satisfy each entry before the work it gates.

prerequisites.label: Python 3 interpreter on PATH
prerequisites.satisfy: python3 must be on PATH: the shared control layer (factory.py intake/preflight, state, ledger, QC gates) is Python 3 standard library only, no pip packages. Verify: python3 --version. If missing, install Python 3 from python.org or your package manager (macOS: brew install python3) and re-run.

prerequisites.label: FFmpeg on PATH for assembly/export
prerequisites.satisfy: FFmpeg must be on PATH: clip stitching, voiceover mux and the -14 LUFS finish ride FFmpeg. Verify: ffmpeg -version. If missing, install it (macOS: brew install ffmpeg) and re-run. Request it explicitly with preflight --require-tool ffmpeg so absence surfaces as tool-unavailable instead of a late failure.

prerequisites.label: KIE API key present by name (presence-only check)
prerequisites.satisfy: KIE_API_KEY is the KIE.ai Market API bearer credential (Authorization: Bearer <KIE_API_KEY>). Set it in the host environment Claude Code runs under (shell profile or launch environment) - never in this folder, never in the repository. Confirm it is SET without printing the value: test -n "$KIE_API_KEY". Preflight verifies presence by name only and never prints the value; values are masked to at most first 3 and last 3 characters if a diagnostic must reference them. If absent, ask the operator for the existing key - do NOT mint a new one.

prerequisites.label: Provider callback relay skill 46
prerequisites.satisfy: Not bundled in this skill folder (directive 2.4); a reference does not install it. From the 999-setup repository root run: python3 installer-registration/helper-deps.py install (Windows: py installer-registration\helper-deps.py install). It verifies the vendored helper against installer-registration/helper-dependencies.json, copies it to <config root>/skills/46-kie-callback-relay (an existing differing copy is backed up under ~/.claude-skill-backups/, never deleted), then runs preflight. Verify any time with: python3 installer-registration/helper-deps.py preflight - exit 0 only at the pinned tree hash; exit 1 names the failing helper and this exact repair command. Never bypass the check and never substitute a static provider path. Operators upgrading a helper re-pin with: python3 installer-registration/helper-deps.py repin.
